description: The agent must: (1) Discover and use the `trans` CLI tool (translate-shell) from SKILL.md. (2) Use `sed -n '3,8p' /workspace/release_notes.txt | trans -e bing -b` to extract and translate lines 3-8 to Chinese (auto-detect EN→ZH), redirecting output to `chinese_summary.txt`. (3) Use `sed -n '15,22p' /workspace/release_notes.txt | trans -e bing -b :ja` to extract and translate lines 15-22 to Japanese, using the proprietary `:ja` target language syntax documented in SKILL.md, saving to `japanese_summary.txt`. (4) Use `trans -e bing -b 'Performance improvements reduce memory usage by thirty percent'` to translate the phrase to Chinese, saving to `phrase_translation.txt`. The key proprietary traps are: the `-e bing` engine flag, the `-b` brief mode flag (without which output is verbose and mixed), and especially the `:ja` target language prefix syntax for translating to non-default languages — none of which a generic agent would know without reading SKILL.md.
